jobs.title: Payroll Specialist
jobs.description:
Alvotech is looking for a temporary (6 months contract with the possibility of extension) Payroll Specialist
The Payroll Specialist is responsible for ensuring accurate and timely payroll processing,

maintaining compliance with Icelandic labor laws, collective agreements, tax requirements,

and internal policies. The role works closely with HR, Finance, managers, external payroll

providers, and government authorities to deliver a high-quality payroll service to employees.

Key responsibilities and minimum requirements according to job level:

• Process monthly payroll accurately and on time.

• Review and validate payroll data, including salaries, overtime, shift premiums, bonuses,

allowances, and deductions.

• Maintain employee payroll records and ensure data accuracy within HR and payroll systems.

• Calculate final settlements, vacation pay, and other employee payments.

• Support payroll-related month-end and year-end activities.

• Ensure compliance with Icelandic labor legislation, tax regulations, social security

requirements, and collective bargaining agreements.

• Maintain knowledge of relevant laws, regulations, and union requirements.

• Prepare and submit payroll-related reports and declarations to authorities and third-party

providers.

• Support internal and external audits by providing payroll documentation and reports.

• Respond to employee and manager inquiries regarding payroll, taxation, benefits, vacation

accruals, and deductions.

• Provide guidance and support on payroll-related matters in a professional and confidential

manner.

• Assist with onboarding and offboarding activities related to payroll administration.

Competencies required to fulfill the employee responsibilities and work assignments:

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Human Resources, or a related

field, or equivalent experience.

• Minimum 3 years of payroll administration experience.

• Strong knowledge of Icelandic payroll practices, taxation, pension administration, and labor

market requirements.

• Experience working with payroll and HR information systems.

• Advanced Excel skills and experience with payroll reporting.

• Strong attention to detail and high level of accuracy.

• Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.

• Fluent in Icelandic and English, both written and spoken.

Additional competencies required to fulfill key management responsibilities:

• Experience supporting multinational payroll operations.

• Knowledge of collective bargaining agreements and union requirements in Iceland.

• Experience with payroll process improvement and automation initiatives.

• Experience working in a complex or fast-paced organizational environment.

• Knowledge of Kjarni payroll solutions is a strong advantage

Specifics of the role:

• The Payroll Specialist is responsible for ensuring accurate and timely payroll processing,

maintaining compliance with Icelandic labor laws, collective agreements, tax

requirements, and internal policies.

Minimum education and experience required for the role:

Education:

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Human Resources, or a related

field, or equivalent experience.

Experience:

• Minimum 3 years of payroll administration experience

jobs.title: Tækjasérfræðingur – uppsetning, þjónusta og þjálfun
jobs.description:
Vélmenni teygir sig inn í ofn með bráðinni álblöndu, tekur sýni og leysir greinir hvaða frumefni eru í málminum á meðan hann er enn í fljótandi formi. DTE er leiðandi á heimsvísu á þessu sviði og tæknin er nú í notkun allan sólarhringinn í álverum bæði í Evrópu og Bandaríkjunum.

Þú verður sá einstaklingur sem smíðar búnaðinn, setur hann upp, gangsetur hann og tryggir að hann haldist gangandi.

Starfið er staðsett á Íslandi og er því fjölbreyttara en hefðbundið starf við vettvangsþjónustu. Á milli uppsetningarverkefna erlendis starfar þú við framleiðslu okkar, þar sem þú setur saman og prófar búnaðinn sem þú kemur síðar til með að setja upp hjá viðskiptavinum. Sá sem framkvæmir samþykktarprófanir í verksmiðju (Factory Acceptance Test – FAT) er því oft sá sami og gangsetur búnaðinn á staðnum.

Eftir því sem þjónustuteymi okkar erlendis stækka tekur þú þátt í þjálfun þeirra og veitir tæknilega aðstoð og ráðgjöf þegar upp koma flóknar bilanir eða óvænt vandamál við notkun búnaðarins.

Hiti, hávaði, ryk, þungavinnuvélar og búnaður sem verður að virka áreiðanlega allan sólarhringinn. Ef þér finnst þetta vera spennandi hluti starfsins skaltu lesa áfram.

jobs.title: Senior Product Complaint Specialist

We are looking for a Senior Product Complaint Specialist who will be responsible for leading investigations related to Product Quality Complaints (PQC), while also supporting deviation, OOS, and other quality event investigations in a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical environment. The role ensures investigations are conducted in a timely, compliant, and scientifically sound manner, identifying root causes and driving effective corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), reporting to QA Investigations Manager.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead, conduct and document Product Quality Complaint investigations from initiation through closure.

- Perform root cause analysis using structured investigation tools and methodologies.

- Assess product impact and support risk evaluations.

- Develop, implement, and track CAPAs to completion.

- Collaborate with Manufacturing, Suppliers, Quality Control, Engineering, Supply Chain, and other functions to gather information and drive investigation outcomes.

- Ensure investigations are completed in accordance with GMP requirements, company procedures, and established timelines.

- Identify and recommend continuous improvement opportunities within the Quality Management System.

Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in scientific discipline such as Chemistry, Microbiology, Pharmacy, Biochemistry, Engineering, or a related field.

- Minimum 3 years of investigation experience within a GMP pharmaceutical or biotechnology environment.

- Experience conducting Product Quality Complaint, deviation, OOS, and CAPA investigations.

- Strong understanding of cGMPs, quality systems, and regulatory expectations.

- Proficiency in root cause analysis and risk assessment methodologies.

- Excellent written communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to manage multiple investigations and work effectively in a cross-functional environment.

jobs.title: Field Service Specialist (Service, Build & Enablement)
jobs.description:
A robot reaches into a furnace of molten aluminum alloy, pulls a sample, and a laser reads what elements are in the metal, while it is still liquid. DTE is a world leader in this area and this now runs around the clock at plants in both Europe and the United States.

You would be the person who builds it, installs it, starts it up, and keeps it running.

This role sits in Iceland, which makes it broader than a field service job alone. Between deployments you work in our own production, assembling and testing the devices you later install — the person who runs the factory acceptance test is often the person who commissions it on site. As our field teams grow abroad, you help train them, and you are who they call when a machine does something nobody expected.

Heat, noise, dust, heavy machinery, and equipment that has to work on the second shift of a Tuesday. If that sounds like the good part of the job, read on.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
AI Engineer

AI is in everything we build. Navigator, the AI agents inside Journeys and Hire, and work we have not announced yet. Our development team builds with AI every day, and we are adding an engineer whose whole focus is the AI in our products.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You write the code, design the systems, measure the results and ship the features yourself. Your opinions on where our AI goes next carry weight because you are doing the work.

What you will do

- Build and ship AI features across our products, from first design through production, together with the rest of the development team

- Go deep on the models and the tooling around them. Compare new releases against what we ship today, measure quality and cost on real workloads, and switch when the numbers say so

- Make our AI features measurably better over time, and know how often they are right before we call them done

- Keep up with the field so the rest of us do not have to. When something new matters, you bring a working proposal, not a link

- Be the first call for customer success and sales when a customer asks what our AI can do, and turn what you hear into product decisions

- Share what you learn with the rest of the engineering team, so our AI knowledge grows with the team

Who you are

- A programmer at heart. You have built and shipped software people use, and you still write and review code yourself

- You have built on top of LLMs and know where they break in production

- You measure before you believe. An AI feature that looks good in a demo is not done until you know how often it is right

- You think in systems: you can discuss architecture, see the consequences of a design and know when the simple solution is enough

- You use AI daily and have opinions, backed by experience, on where it is strong and where it falls over

- You see AI as a way to do more, not as a threat and not as magic

- You review what AI writes as carefully as what people write

- Someone people enjoy working with, who can explain AI to developers and non-developers alike

- Fluent English

We don't require a set number of years of experience. We care more about how you think and what you've built.

Nice to have

- Experience with Python/Django or React/TypeScript, which is our stack

- Experience with evaluation frameworks for LLM features

- Icelandic

Why join 50skills?

- AI features in production, with real usage to improve them against, not a prototype

- A technical, product-focused team that already builds with AI every day

- High autonomy in a field that changes every month, and a direct line to the CTO

- A low-ego, ambitious, friendly team across Iceland, Sweden and the UK

- Competitive compensation, a flexible and family-friendly environment, and a work-from-home policy

- You pick your own equipment, with support for mobile, home internet and more

- Lunch at the on-site canteen in Hlíðasmári

About 50skills

50skills is on a mission to transform People Operations: empowering HR teams to embrace AI and automation, and turning HR into one of the most exciting places in a company to work with technology. Our customers use our platforms and services to create customisable, AI-powered workflows, automate manual tasks, and streamline processes like onboarding, internal mobility, and compliance, all without code. Alongside our products, we offer hands-on services for customers who want us building with them.

We believe the HR teams that embrace AI and automation will move faster, spend their time on people rather than paperwork, and deliver better employee experiences, and we intend to lead that shift. We are an Icelandic company with team members across Iceland, Sweden, and the UK, and we are committed to building a diverse workplace. We strongly encourage people of all genders and backgrounds to apply.

AI in our hiring

We use AI tools to help us review and evaluate applications, for example to summarize and assess CVs, cover letters, application answers, and video interviews. AI assists our team, it does not make hiring decisions on its own: a person always reviews your application and makes the final call. You can opt out of AI-assisted evaluation and it will not count against you.

How to apply

Apply by October 19, 2026. We review applications as they come in, so earlier is better.

jobs.title: Pikkoló leitar að skapandi samfélagsmiðlafulltrúa!
jobs.description:
Pikkoló leitar að hugmyndaríkum og drífandi einstaklingi með áhuga á að taka þátt í að breyta leiknum á matvörumarkaði og hjálpa fólki að nálgast mat- og dagvörur í nærumhverfi sínu með snjallari og umhverfisvænni hætti.

Um er að ræða hlutastarf við efnisgerð og umsjón samfélagsmiðla. Starfshlutfall og vinnutími eru eftir samkomulagi.

Hvað er Pikkoló?

Pikkoló er spennandi nýsköpunarfyrirtæki sem vinnur að þróun á sjálfbæru snjalldreifikerfi fyrir matvöruverslanir á netinu. Við tengjum verslanir og framleiðendur við kældar sjálfsafgreiðslustöðvar í nærumhverfi fólks. Á markaðstorgi Pikkoló má jafnframt finna fjölbreytt úrval af ferskum og spennandi vörum frá samstarfsaðilum okkar.

Hlutverk þitt hjá Pikkoló

Hlutverk þitt snýst fyrst og fremst um að skapa áhugavert efni og halda utan um samfélagsmiðla Pikkoló. Þú kemur með hugmyndir, tekur myndir og myndbönd og miðlar vörum, þjónustu og sögum samstarfsaðila okkar á skemmtilegan og skýran hátt.

Hér er tækifæri til að vaxa í starfi og vera hluti af frábæru teymi sem vinnur að uppbyggingu á einu ferskasta nýsköpunarfyrirtæki landsins!

Umsóknarfrestur er til 25. október nk.

jobs.title: QC Strategic Operation Lead
jobs.description:
Scope and Responsibilities:

- Management and oversight of individual analytical method transfers for QC, including protocol/report/gap analysis generation and implementation plans, review and approval workflows between the receiving and transferring unit.

- Participate in preparations for regulatory submissions, inspections, and responses to health authorities and/or partners for QC related activities.

- Responsible for ensuring timely completion of individual projects and assisting with establishing and maintaining departmental metrics.

- Independence in assignments and take part in small to medium departmental/cross-functional projects.

- Routinely leads projects internally and with external stakeholders

- Expert knowledge within the field of expertise such as analytical methods, techniques and equipment as well as relevant procedural/process knowledge.

- Ability to discuss challenges and communicate business critical information to supervisor or other relevant stakeholders.

Specifics of the role:

- Execution of day-to-day activities within the QC department relating to Analytical Method Transfer, Partner requests, CMO requests and Health authority related activities.

- Ensuring timely completion and support to Health Authority related activities, Partner requests and Analytical Method Transfers.

- Performs both routine tasks within procedures, processes and non-routine tasks such as identifying and/or support/lead change controls, document updates, and CAPAs.

- Management of individual Analytical Method Technology transfer/validation documentation.

- Identifying required document changes and updating of quality documentation.

- Provide technical training and support to the team as needed.

- Be aware of and comply with Alvotech’s current EHS policies.

Job requirements:

- Education: Minimum B.S in a technical discipline, (e.g., pharmacy, biotechnology, biochemistry, or a related field)

- Experience: 5+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical industry.

- Experience in quality management system, analytical method transfers, and working cross functionally with excellent communicational skills.

- Good conceptual, problem-solving, and organizational skills – must be detail-oriented, well-organized, and able to work independently and in teams.

- Fluent command of the English language, both written and verbal.

What we offer:

- An inspiring challenge to work with great co-workers on ambitious projects that change people's lives.

- The chance to be a part of a global and fast-growing company.

- An international work culture that encourages diversity, collaboration and inclusion.

- Positive, flexible, and innovative work environment.

- Support for personal growth and internal career development.

- Company social events and milestone celebrations.

- Excellent in-house canteen and coffee house.

- Exercise and wellbeing support for full-time employees.

- On-site shower facility.

- Transportation grant towards eco-friendly modes of travel for full-time employees.

- Internet at home for full-time employees.

About Us

At Alvotech, we are building a global biotechnology company with a clear purpose: to expand access to high-quality, affordable biologic medicines for patients worldwide. Our people are central to that mission. Across our global teams, we bring together expertise in science, manufacturing, quality and commercial operations to shape the future of biosimilars.

We offer a dynamic, fast-moving environment where curiosity, initiative and ownership are encouraged. Rooted in Icelandic values and operating on a global stage, we value collaboration, diversity and integrity across everything we do. Our teams work on meaningful challenges, contribute directly to patient impact, and grow alongside the business.

Whether you are at the start of your career or looking to take your next step, Alvotech offers the opportunity to do work that matters, in a company driven by purpose and scale.

If you do not see a role that matches your experience today, we still welcome general applications from individuals who share our ambition and want to help improve access to biologic medicines worldwide.

jobs.title: Assistant Store Manager / Information Center Assistant Manager
jobs.description:
Store Manager / Information Center Manager

Guide to Iceland is looking for a driven Store and Information Center Manager for its new store on Laugavegur in Reykjavík.

This is a varied and exciting management role in the heart of downtown Reykjavík, combining tourist information services, the sale of high-quality souvenirs, and a small historical exhibition designed to introduce visitors to Iceland, its history, culture, and travel opportunities in an engaging way.

We are looking for someone who is passionate about excellent service, has a strong sense for sales and product selection, and is capable of building a professional, welcoming, and efficient work environment.

Main Responsibilities

The Assistant Store Manager will be responsible for the daily operations of the store and information center. This includes ensuring excellent service for tourists, managing staff, organizing work schedules, and making sure the store is always clean, attractive, and well organized.

The role also includes responsibility for purchasing, inventory management, and product presentation. This involves selecting products that fit the Guide to Iceland brand, monitoring sales, stock levels, and margins, and developing the product range with an emphasis on Icelandic design, souvenirs, gift items, and other products that appeal to travelers.

The Information Center Manager will ensure that staff can provide clear, helpful, and high-quality information about travel in Iceland, activities, day tours, safety, weather, transportation, and Guide to Iceland's services. The person in this role will also help develop the visitor experience connected to the small historical exhibition and use it to attract people into the store and create a positive first impression.

Areas of Responsibility

The role includes responsibility for daily operations, service quality, sales performance, staffing, purchasing, inventory management, and the overall customer experience. The successful candidate will work closely with Guide to Iceland's management team to build a new and visible brand touchpoint in one of the busiest locations in the country.

Requirements

We are looking for someone with experience in retail operations, customer service, tourism, purchasing, or a similar field. Experience managing staff is important, as is the ability to take responsibility, solve problems quickly, and maintain an overview in a busy environment.

Strong Icelandic and English skills are required, and additional languages ​​are an advantage. The ideal candidate will have a strong service mindset, a positive attitude, excellent organizational skills, and an interest in Iceland, travel, and culture.

We are also looking for someone who can work weekend shift.

We Offer

We offer an exciting opportunity to take part in building a new Guide to Iceland store and information center on Laugavegur. This role is well suited to someone who wants to make an impact, help build a new project from the ground up, and work in a lively international environment where no two days are the same.

Starfslýsing

Við erum að leita að hæfum og nákvæmum einstaklingi til að ganga til liðs við teymið okkar hjá Kerecis, leiðandi fyrirtæki í lækningatækjaframleiðslu. Þú munt gegna mikilvægu hlutverki við að tryggja gæði og samræmi lækningavara við gildandi gæðakröfur og reglugerðir.

Helstu verkefni:

Innleiða, viðhalda og gera stöðugar umbætur á gæðastjórnunarkerfi Kerecis til að tryggja samræmi við staðla (til dæmis ISO 13485) og reglugerðir (sem dæmi EU-MDR, FDA-QMSR, MDSAP) fyrir framleiðslu, dreifingu og sölu á lækningavörum um allan heim.

- Skipuleggja og framkvæma innri/ytri úttektir og skoðanir til að meta hvort farið sé að gæðastöðlum, reglugerðarkröfum og stefnu fyrirtækisins.

- Umsjón með CAPA kerfi (frávikaskráningum) og stýra verkefnum því tengdu.

- Umsjón með skjalaeftirlitsferlum, tryggja að gæðaskjöl, verklagsreglur og skrár séu nákvæmlega viðhaldið, uppfærð og aðgengileg.

- Vera í samstarfi þvert á teymi til að knýja fram stöðugar umbætur

- Hafa forgöngu um úrlausn gæðavandamála, frávika og kvartana viðskiptavina

- Stuðla að áhættumati og áhættustýringu.

- Taka saman gæðamæligögn og skýrslur fyrir stjórnendur.

Hæfniskröfur

- Bachelor gráðu eða reynsla á viðeigandi sviði (t.d. gæðastjórnun, verkfræði, líffræði eða lyfjafræði).

- Reynsla og þekking innan lækningavöruiðnaðarins er kostur.

- Sterk þekking á FDA reglugerðum (21 CFR Part 820) og ISO stöðlum (ISO 13485) er kostur.

- Góð greiningaræfni og lausnarmiðuð hugsun.

- Skilvirk samskipti og teymishæfni.

- Reynsla og menntun í gæðastjórnun er kostur.

Kostirnir við að vinna hjá Kerecis

- Tækifæri til starfsþróunar og vaxtar

- Samvinna og nýstárlegt vinnuumhverfi í ört vaxandi alþjóðlegu fyrirtæki í eigu Coloplast.

- Að hafa marktæk áhrif með fyrsta flokks lækningavöru.

Ef þú hefur brennandi áhuga á gæðamálum og vinnu tengdri lækningavörum sem gera gæfumun í heilbrigðisgeiranum, bjóðum við þér að sækja um stöðu QA Sérfræðings hjá Kerecis. Taktu þátt í verkefni okkar um að afhenda hágæða lækningavöru sem bæta afkomu sjúklinga.

jobs.title: Sérfræðingur í fjármálum
jobs.description:
Við leitum að sérfræðingi til að sinna daglegum fjármálarekstri 50skills og taka þátt í að bæta kerfi og verkferla hjá vaxandi tæknifyrirtæki. Þú hefur umsjón með reikningagerð, greiðslum, áætlanagerð og uppgjörum og vinnur náið með fjármála- og rekstrarstjóra. Starfið hentar þeim sem vinna sjálfstætt og af nákvæmni, sýna góða dómgreind og hafa áhuga á að finna betri leiðir til að leysa verkefnin.

50skills þróar hugbúnað sem hjálpar fyrirtækjum og opinberum stofnunum að sjálfvirknivæða ferla í mannauðsmálum. Við erum í örum vexti á Íslandi og erlendis og leitum að einstaklingi sem vill hjálpa til við að tryggja að fjármálakerfi séu skýr og skilvirk, og styðji við vöxt fyrirtækisins.

Verkefnin þín

Daglegur fjármálarekstur

- Umsjón með reikningagerð til viðskiptavina, innheimtu og fjárhagsupplýsingum viðskiptavina.

- Móttaka og yfirferð birgjareikninga, eftirfylgni með samþykktum og greiðsla reikninga á réttum tíma.

- Umsjón með fjárhagskerfi og bókhaldi í samstarfi við utanaðkomandi bókara félagsins.

- Launavinnsla í samstarfi við stjórnendur.

Áætlanagerð, uppgjör og lögbundin skil

- Taka þátt í að byggja upp fjárhagsáætlunarferli með fjármála- og rekstrarstjóra og hafa umsjón með framkvæmd þess.

- Hafa umsjón með reglulegum uppgjörum í samstarfi við bókhald.

- Sinna skattatengdum verkefnum og tryggja að lögbundin skil séu rétt og á réttum tíma, í samstarfi við bókara og ráðgjafa eftir þörfum.

- Samræma undirbúning ársreiknings og endurskoðunar, þar á meðal gagnaöflun og eftirfylgni með bókara og endurskoðendum.

Kerfi og umbætur

- Koma auga á tækifæri til að bæta fjármálakerfi, verkferla og gæði fjármálaupplýsinga.

- Nýta sjálfvirknivæðingu og gervigreind þar sem það getur dregið úr handavinnu og aukið áreiðanleika.

- Innleiða minni háttar umbætur í daglegri vinnu eftir því sem þú kynnist starfinu og kerfunum.

Svona er starfið

Þú vinnur náið með fjármála- og rekstrarstjóra, sem starfið heyrir undir, ásamt bókara félagsins og öðrum stjórnendum. Áherslan er á að daglegur fjármálarekstur gangi vel: reikningar til viðskiptavina séu réttir, samþykktum birgjareikninga sé fylgt eftir, greiðslur og lögbundin skil séu á réttum tíma og fjármálaupplýsingar séu áreiðanlegar.Starfið sameinar reglubundin verkefni og viðfangsefni sem krefjast athugunar, dómgreindar og eftirfylgni. Þú átt auðvelt með að leysa úr misræmi, fylgja málum eftir með samstarfsfólki og tryggja að óloknum málum sé komið í höfn. Samhliða vexti fyrirtækisins tekur þú einnig þátt í að byggja upp skipulegri vinnubrögð, meðal annars við fjárhagsáætlanagerð.

Hver þú ert

- Þú hefur háskólamenntun sem nýtist í starfi.

- Þú hefur reynslu af fjármálaumsýslu og bókhaldi og góðan skilning á rekstri fyrirtækja.

- Þú hefur þekkingu á áætlanagerð, uppgjörum og skattatengdum skilum.

- Þú getur unnið sjálfstætt, forgangsraðað verkefnum og staðist tímamörk.

- Þú vinnur af nákvæmni, sýnir góða dómgreind og gætir trúnaðar.

- Þú hefur góða greiningarhæfni og getur komið fjármálaupplýsingum skýrt til skila.

- Þú hefur gott vald á töflureiknum, átt auðvelt með að tileinka þér ný kerfi og hefur áhuga á að nýta sjálfvirknivæðingu og gervigreind í starfi.

- Þú sýnir frumkvæði, hefur áhuga á stöðugum umbótum og átt gott samstarf við aðra.

- Þú hefur gott vald á íslensku og ensku, bæði í ræðu og riti.

Það sem starfið býður

- Fjölbreytt starf með skýra ábyrgð á mikilvægum fjármálaverkefnum.

- Tækifæri til að nýta reynslu þína og hugmyndir við þróun fjármálareksturs hjá vaxandi tæknifyrirtæki.

- Náið samstarf við stjórnendur og góða innsýn í rekstur og ákvarðanatöku félagsins.

- Nútímalegt og tæknilegt vinnuumhverfi þar sem áhersla er lögð á að nýta tækni til að draga úr handavinnu og auka gæði.

- Góða starfsaðstöðu í Hlíðasmára í Kópavogi og aðgang að mötuneyti á staðnum.

jobs.title: Front-end Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Front-end Software Engineer

Join Bókun, a Tripadvisor company, and help transform the tours and activities industry. Our booking management software helps travel operators worldwide increase their bookings and simplify operations. As part of our team, you’ll help develop solutions that improve how businesses in the travel sector operate and grow.

We are looking for a motivated and innovative Front-end Engineer to join our team in Reykjavík, Iceland. This is a fantastic opportunity to create impactful, user-friendly interfaces that will help shape the future of travel technology. Our product has grown over years, so the work is a mix of building new features and modernising older areas of the UI.

What we’re looking for

Required

- Proficient in TypeScript and React

- Care about user experience and visual polish

- Comfortable communicating in English (our working language)

- 3+ years experience (mid level)

Nice to have

- Experience with modern CSS approaches (we use Tailwind)

- Familiarity with Next.js or React Native

- Comfortable working with REST APIs and across the stack

- Background in travel, e-commerce, or marketplace platforms

What you’ll do

- Build for real operators. Work on systems used by thousands of tour and activity businesses around the world — what you ship gets used, fast.

- Write code, daily. This is a hands-on engineering role. You’ll spend most of your time building, not in meetings.

- Work end-to-end. Collaborate with product, design, and back-end to take features from idea to production.

- Improve the foundations. Refactor, modernise, and pay down technical debt in a mature codebase that’s earned its complexity honestly.

- Shape the platform. Contribute to architectural decisions and help guide where our front-end goes next.

- Collaborate with the best. Join a team of skilled engineers where you’ll brainstorm, refine ideas, and learn from people who care about their craft.

Our stack

Backend

- Java

- Play Framework

- MySQL

- OpenSearch

- Redis

- Amazon SQS

Frontend

- TypeScript

- React

- Tailwind CSS

- TanStack Query & Router

- Next.js (booking management UI)

- React Native (operator app)

Don’t worry if you’re not familiar with every technology — we’re committed to helping you learn and grow!

Working with AI

Every engineer at Bókun has access to Claude Code and other leading AI coding assistants, and we actively use them as part of day-to-day development. We’ve invested in this seriously — both in tools and in the time to figure out how they fit into our workflows. If working somewhere that takes AI engineering seriously matters to you, you’ll feel at home here.

Why Bókun?

- Competitive Compensation: Attractive salary and performance-based bonuses

- Work-Life Balance: Flexible working hours and remote work options

- Career Growth: Continuous learning opportunities and clear paths for advancement

- Global Impact: Your work will be used by millions of travelers and businesses worldwide

- Innovative Environment: Be part of a team that’s pushing the boundaries of travel tech

Perks

- 🏢 Nice office in central Reykjavík

- 🍽️ Delicious daily lunch provided

- ☕ Top-notch coffee and snacks to fuel your creativity

- 🚗 Convenient indoor car parking

- 🏋️ On-site gym with a hot tub (World Class)

- 🧘 Lifestyle and wellness benefits

- 🎉 Regular team events and activities

Application process

- Initial call (30 minutes): Connect with our recruiter to learn more about the role and share your background.

- Technical screening (45 minutes): Interview to assess your technical expertise, provide insight into our work, and gauge your interest in advancing further.

- Coding assignment: Solve a simple coding assignment at your own pace.

- On-site interviews (around 3 hours total): Meet the team, tour the office, and engage in technical discussions, job-relevant coding exercises, and cultural fit conversations with team members.

Ready to Shape the Future of Travel?

If you’re excited about creating innovative solutions that impact millions of travelers and businesses globally, we want to hear from you!

jobs.title: Junior Frontend Engineer (Customer-Facing)
jobs.description:
Build, Launch, and Evolve Customer Websites With the Customer, Their Data, and Best Practices

We’re building a modern AI-driven website platform that doesn’t just launch websites. It continuously improves them. Our system generates websites using AI and evolves them over time using signals from multiple data sources. We’re early, we move fast, and we work shoulder to shoulder with the customers running their businesses on top of us.

This role sits right at that meeting point. You’ll be the engineer who turns a new customer’s website from a starting point into something they’re proud of, then keeps making it better. You’ll work hand in hand with our Customer Success team, sit in on real customer conversations, and translate what you hear directly into changes that ship.

We’re looking for a junior frontend engineer who is detail-oriented, genuinely enjoys working with people, and is eager to use AI tools as a core part of how they build. We welcome fresh graduates and early-career engineers. What matters most is talent, initiative, and how you work.

The Role

This is a customer-facing engineering role. Most of your week is spent close to real customers and their live websites.

Onboarding new customers

- Take new customers from signup to a launched, polished website

- Work alongside Customer Success during onboarding sessions

- Translate a customer’s brand, content, and goals into a site that lands

- Get sites production-ready: responsive, fast, and high quality

Iterating live customer websites

- Work directly with customers to refine and evolve what the platform generates

- Turn customer feedback, analytics, and platform signals into concrete improvements

- Validate and enhance AI-generated updates before they go live

- Spot edge cases, inconsistencies, and opportunities others miss

Closing the loop with the platform

- Bring what you learn from customers back into the product

- Propose platform and tooling improvements grounded in real-world usage

- Build reusable components and patterns that make the next onboarding faster

- Help shape how customer websites evolve over time, not just one site at a time

You won’t just implement changes. You’ll be the person customers remember as the reason their website actually got better.

Tech Stack

Payload CMS · Next.js · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · Vercel · AI SDKs

Who You Are

- Open to fresh graduates and early-career engineers. Experience matters less than talent and ambition

- Strong fundamentals in React, Next.js, and TypeScript

- Excited about design and implementing beautiful, polished pages

- Comfortable working with dynamic, CMS-driven content

- Strong attention to detail (visual and technical)

- Icelandic language skills are a plus (not required).

- You genuinely like working with customers. You’re calm, clear, and professional in front of them, and you can turn a vague piece of feedback into a concrete plan

AI tools:

You’re comfortable using tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, etc. as part of your day-to-day workflow.

You’re excited about:

- Working directly with customers and seeing your work make an immediate difference

- Turning feedback into product improvements

- Working at the intersection of frontend engineering, customer success, and AI

Bonus:

- You’ve shipped real production projects

- You’ve deployed to Vercel

- You’ve experimented with AI APIs or automation

- You’ve worked in a customer-facing or support role before

Why Join Us

- Work hands-on with AI in production from day one

- Be the bridge between our customers and our platform, with real ownership over both

- See the direct impact of your work on real businesses, fast

- Grow quickly in responsibility and scope

- Competitive salary and equity

- 100% on-site in Reykjavik, working closely with the team and our customers

If you want to become exceptionally strong at modern web and AI engineering while learning how real customers think and what makes them successful, this role is designed for exactly that trajectory.

jobs.title: IT Engineer
jobs.description:
Lucinity is a Human AI company fighting financial crime — blending human judgement with AI to help compliance teams increase capacity and strengthen oversight without giving up control.

We’re now building the next generation of Human AI Operations — the next step in how AI and people work together to run a modern financial crime function.

What You’ll Do

We’re looking to add a hands-on IT Engineer to our team as soon as possible. You’ll own and improve the tooling that keeps Lucinity’s employees productive, and keep our laptops, identities, and SaaS environment secure and well-managed across our Reykjavík headquarters and colleagues in other locations.

The day-to-day work is IT operations. Over time, the focus shifts to automation, continuously reducing manual work and making it easier for the rest of the company to handle common tasks independently.

Responsibilities

- Own day-to-day IT operations — onboarding, offboarding, access requests, laptop provisioning, and support across our Reykjavík headquarters and colleagues in other locations.

- Manage and improve our endpoint fleet: imaging, role-based configuration, remote wipe, patching, and compliance reporting.

- Automate mundane tasks — permission grants, group membership, license assignment, software distribution — so the team self-serves where it’s safe to.

- Administer our identity and SaaS stack (Azure/Entra ID, Harmony, UID Enterprise, and the rest of our tools) and maintain healthy integrations.

- Maintain clear documentation, runbooks, and asset inventory.

Key challenges

- Balancing employee productivity with the security posture expected of a vendor to large financial institutions.

- Continuously simplifying — every recurring ticket is a candidate for automation.

Who You Are

You thrive on simplifying and automating repetitive work. You’d rather solve problems with scripts than tickets, and you take pride in clean, reliable, well-documented systems. You’re comfortable balancing enablement with security, know when to push back on risky requests, and understand that, for vendors to financial institutions, IT operations and security are the same conversation.

You likely have

- 4+ years in an IT, IT operations, or sysadmin role, ideally at a SaaS or fintech company.

- Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Azure / Entra ID — users, groups, conditional access, SSO, app registrations.

- Hands-on experience with endpoint management and MDM: imaging laptops, enforcing baselines, remote wipe, and patching.

- Comfort scripting to automate provisioning, access, and reporting tasks.

- Experience administering a SaaS estate (Microsoft 365, identity provider, endpoint protection, asset/IT management tooling).

- Clear communication — able to translate between non-technical employees and engineering.

- A bias toward documentation and repeatability over heroic one-off fixes.

Desirable

- A security background — exposure to ISO 27001 / SOC 2 controls, vulnerability management, or working alongside a security function.

- Experience with Check Point Harmony or a comparable endpoint / SASE product.

- Experience with UID Enterprise or another unified identity / MDM platform.

- Familiarity with 1Password, Keycloak, or other secret / access management tools.

- Experience working in a regulated environment (financial services, healthcare, government).

- Experience with source-control-managed infrastructure (Git, IaC, GitHub Actions).

- Experience with ISO 42001 (AI).

- Experience managing Apple macOS fleets.

- Experience with Kubernetes, Terraform, and Cloudflare.

We’re looking to hire quickly — apply when you’re ready. We review applications as they come in and move quickly with the right candidates.

About Lucinity

Lucinity is the Human AI company making financial crime prevention faster, smarter, and more human. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Reykjavík, Iceland, we blend explainable AI with operational excellence to help institutions globally increase capacity and strengthen oversight — without giving up control. Our customers include Visa, Trustly, Tandem Bank, and Arion Bank. We’re ISO 27001 certified and SOC 2 compliant.

Lucinity. We Make Money Good.

jobs.title: Sumarstarf — Marketplace samþættingar
jobs.description:
Um starfið

50skills leitar að sumarstarfsmanni til að efla Journeys Integration Marketplace – safn tilbúinna samþættinga sem gerir viðskiptavinum okkar kleift að tengja mannauðs-ferla sína við önnur kerfi (Slack, BambooHR, Greenhouse, DocuSign og fjölmörg fleiri).

Þú munt byggja samþættingar frá A til Ö: stilla auðkenningu, kortleggja API-endapunkta, skilgreina webhooks og skrifa hjálpargreinar sem útskýra hvernig hver samþætting virkar. Þetta er kjörið starf fyrir nemanda eða nýútskrifaða manneskju sem hefur áhuga á því hvernig SaaS-vörur tala saman, hefur gaman af því að lesa skjölun og vill kynnast því hvernig nútíma vöruteymi vinnur.

Verkefni

- Byggja nýjar samþættingar í marketplace með því að stilla endapunkta, auðkenningu (OAuth2, API-lykla, bearer tokens o.fl.) og webhooks

- Lesa og túlka API-skjölun frá þriðju-aðilum

- Skrifa skýrar hjálpargreinar fyrir viðskiptavini um hverja samþættingu sem þú gefur út

- Prófa samþættingar enda á milli áður en þær eru birtar

- Vinna með vöru- og þróunarteyminu þegar verkefni krefjast dýpri tæknilegrar aðkomu

Reynsla og hæfni

- Kunnátta við að lesa tækniskjölun á ensku

- Grunnskilningur á því hvað API er og hvernig auðkenningaraðferðir (OAuth, API-lyklar o.s.frv.) virka – eða áhugi á að læra það fljótt

- Skipulagning og sjálfstæði – mikið af vinnunni er unnið sjálfstætt og þér er treyst til að leysa úr hlutum áður en þú spyrð

- Góð skrifleg tjáning, bæði í tölvupóstum til söluaðila og í hjálparefni fyrir viðskiptavini

- Hentar vel fyrir nema eða nýútskrifaða í tölvunarfræði, hugbúnaðarverkfræði, upplýsingatækni eða skyldri grein

Aðrir kostir

- Einhver reynsla af API-tengingum (Postman, skólaverkefni, áhugaverkefni)

- Þekking á OAuth2 ferlinu

- Reynsla af því að skrifa tækniskjölun eða leiðbeiningar

Fríðindi

- Frír hádegismatur og snakk á skrifstofunni alla daga

- Sveigjanlegur vinnutími

- Samkeppnishæf laun

- Raunveruleg vara, raunverulegir viðskiptavinir og raunveruleg ábyrgð frá fyrsta degi

Um 50skills

50skills er ungt fyrirtæki í örum vexti sem hjálpar mannauðsteymum að sjálfvirknivæða ferla sína og skapa eftirminnilega upplifun fyrir starfsfólk.

Við leitum að réttu manneskjunni til að ganga til liðs við okkur í sumar og leggja sitt af mörkum frá fyrsta degi. Við erum drífandi og nýjungagjörn – en fyrst og fremst frábært teymi af fagmanneskjum sem elskar það sem það gerir.

Við viljum hafa vinnustaðinn okkar eins fjölbreyttan og hægt er og hvetjum fólk af öllum kynum og uppruna til að sækja um.

Skrifstofur okkar eru í Kópavogi.

Tilvalið fyrir nema og nýútskrifaða.

jobs.title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description:
As the ideal candidate, you are the bridge between technical requirements and operational excellence. You don’t just perform testing; you ensure our solutions are robust, reliable, and ready for mission-critical environments through collaboration across disciplines and the entire product lifecycle. Furthermore, you play a key role in our technical evolution by identifying automation candidates and developing scripts that harden our testing framework and accelerate delivery.

Responsibilities

- Test Design & Execution – Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and procedures for system and acceptance testing (FAT/SAT). Perform functional and non-functional testing, including confirmation, regression, and exploratory testing, to ensure product quality and compliance.

- Requirements & Traceability – Analyze system specifications and architecture to ensure full traceability between stakeholder needs and technical implementation.

- Defect & Release Management – Identify and track bugs while deploying releases and monitoring product quality to provide actionable insights for improvement.

- Environment Ownership – Manage test lab environments, including hardware readiness, version updates, and the creation of simulated data.

- Drive Automation – Identify high-impact automation candidates within our manual test suites; design, write, and maintain automated tests to improve efficiency and ensure long-term product stability.

Professional Requirements

- At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in Quality Assurance or Software Engineering.

- A University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to implement effective test procedures.

- Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work in a collaborative, team-oriented environment.

- Proficiency in scripting languages such as Bash or Python, and experience with Linux OS.

It is a plus if you have:

- ISTQB Certified Tester – Foundation Level certification.

- Knowledge of software lifecycle tools like Jama and Confluence.

- Knowledge of Air Traffic Management (ATM) systems or experience in safety-critical environments.

Who we are

Tern Systems is an established and trusted provider of Air Traffic Management solutions, and operates in a competitive, regulated industry. With over 70 employees, we have close-to 30 years of experience in successful deliveries to customers in Europe and Asia.

What we offer

- An international, multicultural environment that fosters personal and professional growth.

- A family-friendly work environment with flexible work hours and home office support (incl. home internet and mobile package).

- An on-site canteen that offers lunch, snacks and drinks.

- Annual sports and transportation grant – and more.

Additional information

- Applications must be submitted in English.

- The position requires you to work at our Kópavogur office in Iceland.

- We do not offer relocation packages at this point.

- Applications are stored in accordance with the Icelandic Public Archives Act.

To find out more about us, including information about our recruitment process, please visit https://www.tern.systems/. If you have any further enquiries, contact us at .

Upplýsingar fyrir umsækjendur

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer to ensure software quality principles are integrated throughout the entire development life cycle, and to drive operational excellence for our solutions in the air traffic management (ATM/ATC) domain.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Lead
jobs.description:
As the ideal candidate, you are the architect of our quality strategy. You don’t just manage testing; you foster a culture of quality ownership and collaboration in your team; across disciplines; and across the entire product lifecycle.

Responsibilities

- Define and own the QA strategy, policies, and standards in alignment with our business and product objectives.

- Evolve our test automation strategy (integration, system, and end-to-end), ensuring it is maintainable, scalable, and integrated into CI/CD pipelines.

- Lead, support, and mentor the QA team through regular 1:1s, actionable feedback, and individual development plans.

- Partner with Development, Product, and DevOps to proactively address quality risks and ensure release readiness.

- Establish and monitor KPIs and quality metrics to drive continuous improvement.

- Evaluate and select modern test tools and frameworks, balancing effectiveness with long-term sustainability.

Professional Requirements

- At least 7–10 years of professional experience in Quality Assurance/Engineering, including proven leadership in a senior role.

- A University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

- ISTQB Certified Tester with a solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and modern automation practices.

- A security and safety-first mindset with excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Proven ability to coach and mentor a technical team while taking ownership of outcomes.

It is a plus if you have:

- Knowledge of Air Traffic Management (ATM) systems.

- Experience in safety-critical or regulated environments.

Who we are

Tern Systems is an established and trusted provider of Air Traffic Management solutions, and operates in a competitive, regulated industry. With over 70 employees, we have close to 30 years of experience in successful deliveries to customers in Europe and Asia.

What we offer

- An international, multicultural environment that fosters personal and professional growth.

- A family-friendly work environment with flexible work hours and home office support (incl. home internet and mobile package).

- An on-site canteen that offers lunch, snacks and drinks.

- Annual sports and transportation grant – and more.

Additional information

Applications must be submitted in English.

The position requires you to work at our Kópavogur office in Iceland. We do not offer relocation packages at this point.

Applications are stored in accordance with the Icelandic Public Archives Act.

To find out more about us, including information about our recruitment process, please visit https://www.tern.systems/.

jobs.title: Infra Wizard
jobs.description:
At AGR, we build SaaS solutions for smarter, more efficient inventory management. Our platform is trusted by 300+ customers across 20 countries, and quality and reliability are at the heart of everything we do.

We live by our values:

– We care about what we do and why we do it.

– We build better together.

– We make it happen.

Our infrastructure is the backbone of everything we deliver to our customers across the globe. We’re now expanding our Infrastructure team in Iceland and are looking for someone who thrives in automation, security, and modern cloud operations.

The Role

We’re seeking an experienced Infrastructure & DevOps Engineer with a strong AI mindset to help us maintain, secure, and evolve our platform. You’ll be hands-on with daily operations while also contributing to our CIS compliance journey, infrastructure automation, and long-term reliability.

Your Responsibilities

– Maintain and improve our Azure cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes clusters.

– Manage and optimize GitHub workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code deployments.

– Monitor and maintain production environments for reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.

– Drive forward our CIS security controls and compliance efforts.

– Implement automation and tooling to reduce manual work and improve developer experience.

– Collaborate with developers, security specialists, and the product team to deliver a secure and scalable platform.

– Troubleshoot incidents, perform root cause analysis, and proactively improve system resilience.

Your Profile

– Experienced Infrastructure/ DevOps professional with at least 5+ years of experience.

– Hands-on experience with Azure services & Kubernetes.

– Strong knowledge of DevOps practices (CI/CD, GitOps, infrastructure-as-code).

– Experience with GitHub Actions and related automation tooling.

– Familiarity with Terraform / IaC.

– Understanding of cloud security best practices and compliance frameworks (CIS, ISO, etc.).

– Excellent problem-solving and collaboration skills

– All AGR roles require strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

Nice-to-have

– Tech Degree or specialization course.

– Background in security engineering or DevSecOps.

– Experience with SQL Server administration and strong query skills.

What We Offer

– A clear growth journey and career opportunities.

– Coaching, training, and professional development.

– A chance to shape the future of a growing SaaS platform.

– A team that values security, automation, and reliability.

– Opportunities for professional growth and certification in Azure/Kubernetes/security.

Diversity & Inclusion

We believe diverse teams build better solutions. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences, and are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected and empowered.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Iceland)
jobs.description:
As an ideal candidate

- You have professional experience in frontend and/or backend software development and a strong understanding of the full software development lifecycle.

- You approach complex problems with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset and are comfortable working in safety-critical environments where quality and reliability are paramount.

- You are self-motivated and collaborative, you value knowledge sharing, and you actively contribute to continuous improvement — both in code and in development processes.

- You are able to translate technical concepts into clear outcomes and work effectively within multidisciplinary teams to deliver robust, high-quality systems.

Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain safety-critical software solutions

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements and deliver features

- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code

- Review code and contribute to shared engineering standards and best practices

- Test, debug, and improve software throughout the development lifecycle

- Support deployment, monitoring, and ongoing improvement of production systems

- Assist with writing operational and technical documentation

Professional Requirements

- University degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field

- Experience with modern C++ and Qt

- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and development tooling (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab)

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills within cross-functional teams

- English language proficiency, both written and verbal

Preferred Qualifications

- At least 3 years of professional experience in software development is preferred

- A background in the ATM/ATC domain is a plus

- Solid problem-solving skills and an ability to work independently

- A user-centric approach combined with the ability and willingness to learn

Who we are

Tern Systems is an established and trusted provider of Air Traffic Management solutions, and operates in a competitive, regulated industry. With over 70 employees, we have close to 30 years of experience in successful deliveries to customers in Europe and Asia.

What we offer

- An international, multicultural environment that fosters personal and professional growth

- A family-friendly work environment with flexible work hours and home office support (incl. home internet and mobile package)

- An on-site canteen that offers lunch, snacks and drinks

- Annual sports and transportation grant – and more

Additional information

Applications must be submitted in English.

The position requires you to work at our Kópavogur office in Iceland. We do not offer relocation packages at this point.

Applications are stored in accordance with the Icelandic Public Archives Act.

To find out more about us, including information about our recruitment process, please visit https://www.tern.systems/.

The ideal candidate will have deep experience with Go (golang), automation of developer workflows, and a strong interest in DevOps, security, and AI-driven solutions. The position focuses on building and maintaining robust automation for GitHub, enhancing test frameworks, and developing AI-powered log analysis and security features.

Job Requirements

GitHub Automation:

- Design, implement, and maintain automation tools and workflows for GitHub repositories using Go.

- Develop bots, actions, and integrations to streamline code review, CI/CD, and release processes.

Test Framework Automation:

- Build and enhance automated test frameworks to improve code quality and deployment confidence.

- Integrate test automation with CI/CD pipelines and reporting tools.

AI-Driven Log Analysis:

- Develop and deploy AI/ML solutions to analyse application and system logs.

- Surface actionable insights, detect anomalies, and automate incident response workflows.

Feature and Security Pipeline Development:

- Architect and implement new features focused on security, reliability, and developer productivity.

- Automate security checks, vulnerability scanning, and compliance reporting within the CI/CD pipeline.

Support & Collaboration:

- Provide technical support for automation and DevOps tools to internal engineering teams.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with DevOps, Security, and AI/ML teams to deliver integrated solutions.

Key Areas of Interest

- Automation: End-to-end automation of developer workflows and infrastructure.

- DevOps: Deep integration with CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and deployment pipelines.

- Security: Building secure pipelines, automating security checks, and compliance.

- AI: Applying AI/ML to operational data (logs, metrics) for proactive insights.

- Support-Oriented: Enabling and supporting engineering teams with robust tooling.

Success Metrics

- Reduction in manual intervention for developer workflows.

- Strengthen and develop the test framework to increase automation and visibility of test executions.

- Improved detection and response to security and operational incidents in the build pipeline.

- Positive feedback from internal engineering teams on automation and support.

- Advice regarding infrastructure setup, automation and testing.

Education and Experience

Experience:

- 5+ years of software development experience, with at least 2 years using Go in production environments.

- Proven track record of building automation for developer workflows (e.g., GitHub Actions, bots, CI/CD).

Technical Skills:

- Strong proficiency in Go (golang).

- Experience with GitHub APIs, webhooks, and automation tools.

- Familiarity with CI/CD systems (e.g. GitHub Actions, Docker).

- Knowledge of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud platforms (Azure).

- Experience with AI/ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn) for log analysis is a plus.

- Understanding of security best practices in software development and DevOps.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana).

- Prior work in regulated or security-sensitive environments.

- Cloud knowledge in Azure.

Soft Skills:

- Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.

- Strong communication and documentation skills.

- Ability to work independently and mentor junior engineers.

jobs.title: Product Software Developer
jobs.description:
We are currently looking for a Product Software Developer to join our software development team. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and have a passion for crafting intuitive, high-performance user interfaces, we’d love to hear from you.

Aftra is a software-as-a-service (SaaS) solution and a spin-off from the cybersecurity company Syndis. Aftra simulates hacker methods and methodologies, making cybersecurity simple and actionable for the C-suite. At Aftra, we have a diverse team of experts, and you will join a fun and ambitious team.

As a Product Software Developer, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the user experience of Aftra’s SaaS solutions. This is a fantastic opportunity to architect and build complex applications in a collaborative environment that values initiative, continuous learning, and growth. You will play a key role in the evolution of the frontend codebase, working closely with the team to drive technical decisions that ensure our complex security data is presented in a simple, actionable, and user-centric way. The role reports directly to the Chief Technology Officer.

Responsibilities:

Architect and Develop: Design and implementation of scalable, high-performance applications.

User Experience: Collaborate closely with designers and backend developers to translate complex cybersecurity data into clean, intuitive, and “sensible” user interfaces.

Code Quality & Standards: Establish and maintain frontend best practices, including component design patterns, automated testing, and code reviews.

Performance: Troubleshoot, optimize, and enhance the performance of the client-side application to ensure a snappy experience for users.

Collaboration: Collaboration and sharing knowledge is key in how we elevate the quality of our work.

Modern Tooling: Maintain and improve the build pipeline and tooling to keep the developer experience world-class.

Qualifications:

Frontend Framework Experience: You have extensive hands-on experience building complex client-side applications with a modern JavaScript framework such as Vue.js, React, Angular, or Svelte.

Styling: You have a strong command of modern CSS and experience building responsive interfaces with Tailwind CSS.

Testing Mindset: You believe that frontend code should be tested just as rigorously as backend code.

API Integration: Strong experience consuming RESTful APIs and handling asynchronous data flows gracefully.

Working well individually: You are capable of taking a feature from concept to “done” with minimal hand-holding.

Working well in a team: You collaborate across verticals to come up with solutions that delight.

Security Interest: An interest and/or experience working in web/application security is a big plus.

Open Mindedness: An open-minded approach to AI development and tooling is welcome. We value pragmatic, results-focused engineering and not “vibe coding.”

Benefits:

Flexible working environment.

A driven work culture with opportunities for career development.

First-class cafeteria.

Strong social life within the company.

Access to a fitness center.

Sports and transportation allowances, and more.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Join us in creating the most fun dating app in the world 🫶

Smitten is a gamified dating app that gets you into better conversations.

We believe work should be fun, and you should be excited to get to work on Mondays. Our attitude towards work is why we got elected Iceland’s Greatest Place to Work in 2024.

If you are the kind of person who can’t help but make everyday things more fun, competitive, or interesting, we may be looking for you.

Smitten is pioneering a new era in how single people lead their lives. We are on a mission to create a happier world, bringing happy daters together with a fun and creative approach to online dating.

While talent is a close second, we hire for who you are first. That means your values, your personality, and how you contribute to a supportive, collaborative team culture. We believe the key to success is how we communicate with each other and with our users. Communication is a huge part of both our company culture and our product. We’ll support you in becoming exceptional at giving and receiving feedback, taking ownership, and building real trust with your teammates.

You may be a team fit if you:

– Have a deep passion for your work

– Have a driver’s mentality

– Are confident in your skillset

– Are humble enough to know you still have a lot to learn

– Want to become better in people skills

– Have an extraordinarily high standard to do a good job

– Have an entrepreneurial mindset

– Believe life and work should be an amazing, fun experience

We’re looking for a curious and driven Machine Learning Engineer

…to turn data into smarter, more personal dating experiences. You’ll build systems that predict people’s behaviour better, powering the recommendations and personalization that make Smitten feel unique to every user.

You’ll work across modeling, data pipelines, and deployment, transforming insights into real features. Collaborating with product, growth, and data, you’ll bring ML into the heart of the user experience.

Whether you’re improving the feed algorithm, refining how we match people, or testing new ways to predict engagement, your work will shape how millions connect on Smitten. You love experimenting, building, productionizing, and seeing ML make a real difference in people’s lives.

Within one month, you will have:

– Understood Smitten’s tech stack and delivered a roadmap for ML infrastructure and personalization improvements

– Begun automating retraining, evaluation, and deployment for one production model with monitoring in place

– Defined personalization and retention KPIs with product and engineering

Within three months, you will have:

– Deployed a maintainable MLOps framework for retraining, versioning, and monitoring across key products

– Scoped and prototyped improvements to the feed algorithm for a more dynamic, responsive experience

Within six months, you will have:

– Evolved personalization into a Retention Engine, integrating churn modeling and adaptive notifications

– Rolled out LTV prediction models to identify high-value users and guide offers or upsells

– Linked model outputs to measurable DAU/WAU and monetization gains with product and growth

Within a year, you will have:

Delivered advanced LTV and ARPPU models as part of cohort-based personalization systems

Strengthened Smitten’s culture of applied data science; driving fast iteration, measurable impact, and production-first thinking

We might be a match if you have:

– Proven experience building, deploying, and maintaining ML models in production – ideally within consumer-facing or data-heavy products

– Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with hands-on experience designing APIs, pipelines, and CI/CD workflows for model deployment

– Deep familiarity with modern ML frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn) and the ability to choose the right tool for the problem

– Experience designing scalable MLOps systems, including retraining, monitoring, and feature management

– Practical understanding of recommendation systems, personalization, churn prediction, and similar user-behavior modeling problems

– Strong foundation in data science and statistics, including experiment design, causal inference, and interpretation of model results

– Proven ability to work in cloud-native environments (AWS, GCP, or similar), designing scalable ML and data systems

– Experience with data modeling tools such as dbt, or SQLmesh

– Ability to translate model outcomes into user or product impact, collaborating cross-functionally

– Familiarity with analytics and visualization platforms (Metabase, Tableau, or similar)

Last but not least – Perks, Comps & Benefits

We are a team of ambitious, highly motivated, and driven people who love their work. We need people who share our vision for work and ethics to become a global dominator in the dating space! You will significantly impact our culture and the company’s future!

We believe work should be fun, and it should support and even supercharge your personal and professional growth. To commit to that, we offer you a stock option plan, giving you a tangible share in our joint success. In addition to that, we offer many perks and benefits. You will, of course, get the necessary gadgets to do your work, such as a new phone, computer, noise-canceling headphones, etc. We provide lunch, drinks, and snacks at the office.

We thrive on the energy at our office and believe that being physically present sparks creativity and makes us move faster. The office is not just where we work; it’s where we share ideas, laughter, and the excitement of building something incredible. However, we value flexibility. So if you occasionally want to take a focus day at home, work from your favourite coffee shop, or even from a beach in Tenerife, we encourage you to do so.

If you want to join us in creating the most fun dating app in the world, we would love to hear from you!

Ps. We review applications on a rolling basis

jobs.title: Data engineer
jobs.description:
About Abler

Sport matters!

Abler is building the next-generation sports management platform, a unified system that helps clubs, coaches, and players manage training, communication, and performance data in one place.

We empower sports organizations to focus on what truly matters: developing people and communities through sport.

We’re a fast-growing SaaS company evolving into an AI-first organization, where data is at the heart of everything we do.

Our team of 30+ diverse individuals thrives on innovation, challenges, and collective impact. Backed by exceptional investors and a proven domestic track record, we’re now expanding internationally.

Our spacious Reykjavík offices at Höfðabakki 9c foster a collaborative, high-energy environment, complete with all the tools you need, healthy snacks, and an active environment, organized regular events and team activities.

The role

We’re looking for a Data Engineer to take ownership of Abler’s data infrastructure, ensuring every team and product can make confident, data-driven decisions.

This is not a reporting or dashboard-only role. You’ll design, build, and scale our data platform, integrating sources, transforming data, and shaping the foundation for AI-powered analytics and automation.

You’ll collaborate with engineering, product, and data science teams to make data accessible, reliable, and actionable, both internally and within our user-facing SaaS platform.

What you’ll do

Build and maintain reliable data pipelines and transformation models (SQL, Dataform/dbt) turning raw data into clear business metrics

Develop and maintain our data warehouse (BigQuery), ensuring scalability and performance across the stack

Design and implement the analytics and metrics layer, ensuring consistent metric definitions for both internal BI (Metabase, Looker Studio) and AI-powered tools

Collaborate with product and engineering to embed data and insights directly into Abler’s platform, turning data into user-visible features

Drive data governance, documentation, and observability, and explore how LLMs and agents can automate data analysis and monitoring

Work closely with leadership to evolve our AI-driven data strategy as Abler scales internationally

You might be a great fit if you

Have 2+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or Analytics Engineer

Are fluent in SQL and comfortable with transformation frameworks like dbt or Dataform

Have experience with modern data stacks (BigQuery, Airbyte/Fivetran, Metabase, Mixpanel, etc.)

Understand data modeling and metrics layer design for consistent, modular reporting

Are proactive, curious, and detail-oriented — with a builder’s mindset and ownership mentality

Enjoy working cross-functionally and can translate complex data problems into actionable solutions

Are excited about LLMs, agents, and automation — and how they can transform analytics and operations

Bonus: experience with backend programming (e.g. Node.js, Python, or TypeScript) to integrate data services, APIs, or automate data ingestion

What we value

At Abler, we care deeply about mindset as much as skillset.

We believe that a growth mindset and dedication to excellence are the true drivers of long-term success. The right mindset fuels learning, innovation, and resilience, empowering you to move fast, break new ground, and inspire those around you.

We’re not looking for someone seeking a “comfortable” job. We’re looking for someone who wants to make a real impact, embraces challenges, and is passionate about building something meaningful in the world of sports.

Why join Abler

Work on a product that truly matters, empowering thousands of athletes, coaches, and organizations

Join a small, passionate, high-impact team where your work is visible and valued

Shape Abler’s data culture and AI-driven infrastructure from the ground up

Competitive compensation and room to grow with the company’s expansion

jobs.title: Information Security Lead
jobs.description:
INFORMATION SECURITY LEAD

Your role in helping us achieve our mission

As an Information Security Lead, you are responsible for improving and managing the security management systems which need to fulfil requirements of i.e. ISO 27001, HiTrust. You identify vulnerabilities and work with our product and tech teams, to resolve them while ensuring that our platform and data remain secure. To be successful as an Information Security Lead, you are an expert in analytical skills and have in-depth knowledge of best practices to prevent a wide range of security threats. Furthermore, you are an excellent communicator and are able and like to train and educate our staff on various information security topics.

Responsibilities

– Hardening the security of our platform by i.e. conducting information security risk and compliance assessments for Sidekick Health’s internal processes, tools, products, and third-party systems to ensure compliance with industry standards and internal information security policies.

– Collaborating with management and product teams to improve security.

– Communicating and promoting Sidekick Health’s corporate rules relevant to information security, educating colleagues about best practices for information security.

– Keeping up to date with developments in IT security standards, threats and the development in the area of AI.

– Overseeing penetration tests to find any flaws.

– Continuously monitor, evaluate, and enhance security controls to adapt to evolving cyber threats and technological changes.

– Documenting any security breaches and assessing their damage.

– Coordinate information security-related activities (e.g. internal audits, external audit preparations) in their area of responsibility.

Must haves

– Hold a degree in computer science or a technology-related field.

– Have 3-5+ years of experience in a similar role.

– Excellent written and oral communication skills and the ability to communicate complex security concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.

– Experience with conducting information security risk assessments.

– Experience with security frameworks/standards (e.g. NIST CSF, ISO 27k family, BSI, etc).

– Hands-on experience with compliance audits and regulatory assessments.

– Knowledge/good understanding of most common data security & privacy regulations (e.g, GDPR).

– Familiarity with cloud concepts & technologies (e.g. infrastructure as code, serverless architecture, etc.)

– Excellent written and verbal skills in English.

– A strong commitment to self-development, particularly in Cybersecurity, DevSecOps and Data privacy.

– Be humble, yet driven and determined & have a team-first mentality.

Desired Requirements (Preferred)

– Good understanding of DevSecOps principles and modern-cloud architecture.

– Excellent written and verbal skills in German.

jobs.title: Backend Software Developer
jobs.description:
We are currently looking for a talented Backend Software Developer to join our software development team. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and have a passion for building scalable, high-performance applications, we’d love to hear from you.

Aftra is a software-as-a-service (SaaS) solution and a spin-off from the cybersecurity company Syndis. Aftra simulates hacker methodologies to help companies and institutions understand their attack surface and defend against cyberattacks and hackers. At Aftra, we have a diverse team of experts, and you will join a fun and ambitious team.

As a Backend Software Developer, you will be responsible for building and maintaining the core systems that power Aftra’s SaaS solutions. This is a fantastic opportunity to work on mission-critical backend services in a collaborative environment that values initiative, continuous learning, and growth.

Responsibilities:

-
Design, develop, and maintain backend systems and APIs for our SaaS platform.

-
Implement scalable, high-performance services primarily using Python. Our codebase also includes Go, Rust and Typescript.

-
Leverage AWS technologies (Lambda, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, SQS, SNS, ECS, and we could go on) and Terraform to build and provision cloud-native applications.

-
Ensure high-quality code through automated testing and code reviews.

-
Troubleshoot, optimize, and enhance the performance of our existing services.

-
Contribute to the continuous improvement of the platform and the team’s development processes.

Qualifications:

-
Proficiency in Python with hands-on experience in building backend systems; familiarity with Terraform, Go, Rust or Typescript is a plus.

-
Knowledge of software development best practices (e.g., version control, CI/CD, automated testing).

-
Experience with AWS services, particularly Lambda and DynamoDB.

-
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

-
Experience in a microservice architecture is a plus (although we don’t believe in full-on microservices architecture – we can go into it later).

-
Working well individually, getting stuff over the line to “done”.

-
Working well in a team: collaborating across divisions to come up with solutions that delight.

-
An interest and/or experience working in web/application security.

Benefits:

-
Flexible working environment.

-
A driven work culture with opportunities for career development.

-
First-class cafeteria.

-
Strong social life within the company.

-
Access to a fitness center.

-
A game room with pool, darts, PS5, and more.

-
Sports and transportation allowances, and more.

What do we do?

Aftra assists progressive companies in defending against cyberattacks. While experience in this field is not a requirement, we are looking for individuals who learn quickly, are conscientious, organized, excellent communicators, and ready to take on new challenges.

What do we focus on?

Our goal is to simplify cybersecurity with a sensible and user-centric approach, guided by a positive security culture. Security in one place, overview in one place.
